author: Marlon Chaviano
name: mcp-server-python
title: MCP server with Python
description: An MCP server in Python with the official SDK (v2, MCPServer): every tool is a typed function, ready to connect to any agent.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Each tool is a function with `@mcp.tool()` in `server.py`: the parameter types are the schema and the docstring is what the model reads.
- **stdout is the protocol**: never use `print()`; log with `logging` (it goes to stderr).
- Test with `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector .venv/bin/python server.py` (opens the inspector).
- To use it in Claude Code: `claude mcp add {{name}} -- $(pwd)/.venv/bin/python $(pwd)/server.py`.
- Before finishing: import the module (`.venv/bin/python -c "import server"`).
